name: identify
description: identify.file: What a file is: format, format families and MIME type, from its first 256 KiB and its name. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.

name: inventory
description: inventory.native: One-call inventory of a native binary: per architecture slice, its kind, interpreter, own name (soname, DLL name or install name), linked libraries, exported and imported symbols, and language markers. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.

name: read
description: read.strings: Printable strings in any file (ASCII and UTF-16LE, at any offset), with their file offsets; optionally only those containing a search text. Pages with offset and limit. read.bytes: A slice of any file: `length` bytes from file offset `at`, as hex and a hexdump. search.bytes: Every file offset where a byte pattern occurs (hex with ?? wildcards, or text with optional ASCII case folding), overlapping matches included. Pages with offset and limit. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.
